name: soapcap
role: The command-line tool with the same goal. Its note prompts, draft checks and de-identification rules are used here.

name: yap
role: Capture and transcription on Apple's SpeechAnalyzer. The capture and segmenting code here is ported from it.

name: llama.cpp, PrismML's fork
role: Runs the note models. Its llama-server is built from source and ships inside the app.

name: Bonsai 2 27B
role: A note model (Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B), built from Qwen3.8-27B. Downloaded separately, not shipped in the app. Created using Bonsai by Prism ML.

name: Llama 3.1 8B
role: A note model (Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, in bartowski's 4-bit conversion). Downloaded separately, not shipped in the app. Built with Llama.

name: OpenMed PII model
role: The on-device model that finds names and other identifying details (OpenMed-PII-ClinicalE5-Small-33M-v1). Downloaded separately, not shipped in the app.

name: OpenMedKit
role: Runs the PII model inside the app.

name: MLX Swift
role: The machine-learning runtime the PII model runs on.

name: swift-transformers
role: The tokenizer that cuts text into the pieces the PII model reads.
